name: Red-leaved autumn creeper fall 115
modifier: a long straightish run with two sharp kinks
prompt: ONE long climbing vine SNAKING and WINDING across a rock face, clinging tight to the stone as it climbs, coiling in slow curves the way a creeper spirals a tree trunk, gripping tendrils along its length, dense clusters of jungle leaves sprouting at points on the vine with bare woody stem between them, the plant's roots far below out of sight, jungle-lush and alive, fantasy RPG nature art, no straight edges, no border, no rock or wall behind it, transparent background, red-leaved autumn creeper fall, a long straightish run with two sharp kinks, towering, many times human height, completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission

placement.note: ONE SCENERY PIXEL IS ONE PLAYER PIXEL. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so scenery is placed into the world at 1:1 exactly as the avatar is (setScale(1)) and the two share one pixel grid. The CAMERA still zooms the whole scene — that is uniform and correct; what must never happen is scenery being resampled on its own, against the player. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.

LIT_1.glow_concept: luminous sap veins glowing through the leaves

LIT_2.glow_concept: pale blue soul-flowers dotted down the fall

motion.description: This is an almost completely still picture. ONLY the cyan flowers on the vine change. Their brightness lifts very slightly and comes straight back: no more than a few pixels change anywhere in the whole picture. At their brightest they are still exactly the same cyan as in the first frame -- never pale, never white, never any other colour. They never fade, never vanish, never spread and never change shape. Nothing is added or removed anywhere, and nothing changes size. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel: same shape, size, position and colour. The last frame matches the first exactly.

light.reference: the spawn bonfire is 1.0 (radius 7); strength 0 is no light
